title: City Office Directory
description: Schema for the administrative offices of the city government. Fields that have not been verified against a civic source are null or empty, never invented or filled with placeholder text. An office is published on the strength of its own citations; its head is a separate claim with its own citations, because the two are corroborated by different sources.

slug.description: URL segment. Lowercase, hyphen-separated, derived from the office name.

office_name.description: Official name of the office as published, cased ready to render.

name_variants.description: Other names the city uses for the same office on its own pages. Kept so a reader searching the name they saw elsewhere still finds the office.

address.description: Null until an authoritative address is sourced. The city publishes an address for only two of its offices.

trunkline.description: Published contact numbers. Empty until an authoritative number is sourced.

website.description: Null until an authoritative page is sourced.

email.description: Null until an authoritative address is sourced.

department_head_status.description: Why the head is or is not published. Distinguishes a detail this portal has not established from an office that has no head, which is never something the absence of a name tells us. `conflicting_sources`: official pages name different people, and nothing establishes which is current. `uncorroborated`: fewer than two independent page families name anyone. `published` requires department_head to be present; both withheld states require it to be null.

department_head.description: Null unless the head is established. Never filled from a single uncorroborated page, and never chosen between sources that disagree.

title.description: The position as published, e.g. "City Legal Officer" or "Officer-in-charge".

sources.description: Civic-source ids naming this person in this post. At least two, because a single page is not enough to establish that a head is current. The tests additionally require the two to come from independent page families: the Directory and the Officials-section roster are near-clones, so agreement between only those two is one editorial act repeated rather than two statements.
Civic-source ids from src/data/sources/civic-sources.json backing the office itself.
